items.title: Inferock Bench
items.name: Inferock Bench
items.summary: An independent receipt for every LLM API call
items.description: Inferock-bench is a local proxy that sits between your app and OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or OpenRouter shaped calls. It captures per-call token usage, failures, and retries, then generates an independent receipt showing what you were billed and how much you're actually overpaying for.
top_comments: auditing your own inference bill is such an obvious gap 🔍 nice one. seeing much overbilling in the wild yet?

Congrats on the launch of Inferock Bench.

Love the idea of having an independent receipt for every LLM API call. Transparent usage, billing, and overpayment tracking can be a huge win for teams working with multiple LLM providers.
Retries are the part I’d put in giant font. ‘$0.04/call’ means nothing if a successful job secretly takes 6 calls. I want cost per accepted outcome.
items.author: [REDACTED] / Himashwetha Gowda
items.why: Product Hunt 当前获得 315 票、57 条评论；仍处在近期新品验证窗口
items.mechanism: 可迁移的机制在于把通用模型能力封装进具体产品形态，让用户按任务而不是按模型来消费能力。
items.routing_reason: 产品是面向开发者的 LLM API 调用本地代理，核心任务是捕获 token 用量和计费差异并生成独立收据，属于开发者工具和成本审计，不服务任何给定兴趣点的核心任务。
items.highlight_one_liner: 每次 LLM API 调用一张独立账单
items.reuse_direction: 把每次 LLM API 调用的 token 用量、失败与重试记录成可对账的独立账单，作为成本审计的具体依据。
items.minimal_mvp: 先做一个本地代理，拦截 LLM API 请求与响应，按每次调用生成包含 token 用量、失败和重试标记的账单记录。
